title: A Sparse Corner-Difference MILP for Minimum Square Tiling
summary: We study the problem of tiling an $N\times N$ square with axis-aligned squares whose side lengths are integers strictly less than $N$, with the objective of minimizing the number of tiles. The standard placement-based exact-cover MILP contains $Θ(N^5)$ placement-to-cell nonzero coefficients and is also affected by the dihedral symmetry of the square domain. We introduce a Corner-Difference MILP (CD-MILP) that represents each selected square by at most four signed corner coefficients.
